p: observe to do according to all: Therefore seeing they did not obey the commandment of God, they were justly cast from the land which they had only on condition.
tingle: Meaning, that whoever hears of this great plague, will be astonished.
of Samaria: As I have destroyed Samaria and the house of Ahab so will I destroy Judah.
remnant of mine inheritance: Meaning, Judah and Benjamin, which were the only ones left of the rest of the tribes.
innocent blood very much: The Hebrews write that he slew Isaiah the prophet, who was his father-in-law.
way of the LORD: That is, according to his commandment.
